label: HARDWARE
frame_note: data_frames: the physical Pauli -> Stim Pauli map of each data qubit through the readout window (device.readout_frames): 'XYZ' the identity, 'ZYX' a Hadamard frame, where a physical Z (dephasing) acts as Stim's X and so flips Z-type detectors and the Z logical
rule: decoder-free: a stabilizer's rate is the mean of its detectors' events over shots and rounds; on pools the DD-on jobs, off the DD-off jobs; a misread is a deterministic first readout (round 1's ancilla readout of the basis's own stabilizer type) that differs from the noiseless value
